runtime_dependency_observation.interpretation: The final doctor run authenticated and returned 30 cameras. Earlier transient timeouts left the persisted registry intact.

limitations: Camera names were not geocoded because that would fabricate authoritative operational coordinates.
An empty isolated-camera list is not evidence of good spatial coverage when zero cameras are geolocated.
Circular coverage buffers do not model occlusion, lens calibration, road topology, or measured recognition range.
Pair feasibility uses geodesic lower-bound distance and does not reconstruct a road route.
